description: Read the PROGRAM ALLOCATION AUCTION, held until a price is named; no bid is taken today. With no id, the lots the house published, newest first, each with its status (upcoming, open or closed), its closing time and the house price. With lotId, one lot in full: its capacity and slots, its times, the hash a bid names, the house price (blank by default, and then none is quoted), the counts of bids once the lot closes (bids are sealed until then), its result once it has cleared, and the notice words. Never a wallet and never a bid. The program is held off until the operator switches it on, and until then the read says so plainly; this tool moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

lotId.description: One lot's id. Leave it out to list the published lots.
